description: Synthetic, manually labelled regression examples. Not a production quality benchmark or a sample of private user documents.

chunks.title: healthcare-governance.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Healthcare AI reviews must consider FDA requirements, the EU AI Act, WHO guidance, privacy, bias and accountability.

chunks.title: employee-handbook.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Policy PTO-2026 grants full-time employees 20 days of paid annual leave. Unused leave carries over for five days.

chunks.title: incident-response.txt
chunks.chunk_text: SLA P1 incidents require an initial response within 15 minutes. P2 incidents require an initial response within four hours.

chunks.title: account-security.txt
chunks.chunk_text: JWT sessions use HS256 and an account-specific stamp. Removing a member invalidates future authenticated requests. Recreating an email does not reactivate old tokens.

chunks.title: billing-policy.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Invoice INV-042 qualifies for a refund within 30 days of payment. Refund requests require the invoice identifier.

chunks.title: data-retention.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Application logs are retained for 30 days. Encrypted database backups are retained for 90 days.

chunks.title: workspace-guide.txt
chunks.chunk_text: Administrators add Member and Administrator accounts in the Members page. Members can browse documents and ask questions, but cannot manage other accounts.

chunks.title: model-hosting.txt
chunks.chunk_text: GPU model serving requires compatible CUDA drivers and enough VRAM. CPU inference is possible but may have higher response latency.

chunks.title: office-guide.txt
chunks.chunk_text: The office opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening. Weekend access requires prior approval.

chunks.title: research-demo.txt
chunks.chunk_text: The polyp detection interface is a research demonstration. It is not for clinical decisions and does not provide a diagnosis.
